abstract: Unilateral renal agenesis is usually asymptomatic and may be found incidentally during examination for other causes. The incidence of testicular tumors arising from cryptorchidism is well established, but if it is coexistent with ipsilateral renal agenesis, the diagnosis and management becomes a challenge. Only three cases of such association have been reported in literature so far. This association has to be kept in mind when dealing with a case of testicular tumor arising from abdominal cryptorchidism, so that the function of the other kidney can be assessed before surgery, and protection given to it in the event of using radiotherapy in an adjuvant setting.
abstract_ja: 停留精巣由来の精巣腫瘍の発生率は確立されているが、同側の腎無形成を伴う場合は、診断と治療の対応が困難となる。このような合併は文献上これまでに3例しか報告されていない。腹腔内停留精巣由来の精巣腫瘍を扱う際には、この関連を念頭に置き、手術前に反対側の腎機能を評価すること、また補助的な放射線療法を行う場合にはその腎を保護することが重要である。
